calibration_note: Rebuilt 2026-07-30 alongside measured-edge-margin-v1 -- same elasticity change to estimate_runs() (see that artifact's note and mlb-analyst-poisson-trend-v0.2.yaml). Unlike margin, totals shows a real, meaningful improvement from the rebuild: raw simulated over-probability correlation with actual over/under outcomes on the same real 162-game/2026-07-01..07-12 backtest went from -0.019..-0.123 (2026-07-29, four formula revisions, all at/below zero -- statistically indistinguishable from no skill) to +0.166 with the rebuilt formula. This is the first time this project has seen positive real signal on MLB totals. Scale/offset here ARE now fit directly from this model's own OLS regression (previously they borrowed margin's fit because the totals-specific fit was degenerate/negative -- no longer the case). Flat -110 diagnostic: 91 selected picks, 56.0% hit rate, +6.36 units. Still only 162 real games and one 12-day window -- promising, not proven; keep model_state/units at research/zero until this holds up on new, independent real settled history.
